name: simple-autocomplete
description: Inline code completion for chat APIs and native fill-in-the-middle APIs, including GreenPT and Mistral Codestral.

commands.title: Simple Autocomplete: Clear Stored API Key
Simple Autocomplete: Suggest Edits Around Cursor

simpleAutocomplete.endpoint.description: Full chat or native FIM endpoint, e.g. https://api.greenpt.ai/v1/chat/completions or https://api.mistral.ai/v1/fim/completions.

simpleAutocomplete.apiMode.description: Auto detects /fim/completions endpoints. Chat sends messages; native FIM sends prompt (code before cursor) and suffix (code after cursor), as supported by Mistral Codestral.

simpleAutocomplete.debounceMs.description: Wait after typing before sending an automatic request. Explicit inline suggestions run immediately.

simpleAutocomplete.model.description: Model ID used for inline completion.

simpleAutocomplete.apiKeySource.description: Read the API key from an environment variable or VS Code SecretStorage.

simpleAutocomplete.apiKeyEnvVar.description: Environment variable containing the API key when apiKeySource is environment.

simpleAutocomplete.systemPrompt.default:
You are an inline code completion engine. You receive a snippet of a file containing a single cursor marker ⟪CURSOR⟫. Write the text that belongs exactly at that marker.

Guidelines:
- Complete the current construct: statement, expression, block, documentation or string.
- Match the language, indentation, quotes, naming, and comment/documentation style of the snippet.
- Stay local. Do not invent or paste code that belongs elsewhere in the file.
- Never repeat text that is already present before or after the marker.
- It is better to return nothing than to guess something the user did not ask for.
simpleAutocomplete.systemPrompt.description: Custom chat system instructions. An insertion response contract is appended automatically. Ignored by native FIM.

simpleAutocomplete.extraBody.description: Extra generation options, e.g. {"reasoning_effort": "none"} when supported by the chat model. Model, stream and context fields are managed by the extension.

simpleAutocomplete.prefixChars.description: Maximum characters of whole-line context before the cursor sent as the snippet.

simpleAutocomplete.suffixChars.description: Maximum characters of whole-line context after the cursor sent as the snippet.

simpleAutocomplete.maxLines.description: Maximum number of completion lines shown as ghost text.

simpleAutocomplete.excludedLanguages.description: Language IDs where inline completion is disabled.

simpleAutocomplete.conservative.description: Suppress automatic requests in low-signal contexts such as empty top-level lines. Explicitly triggered inline suggestions still run.

enumDescriptions: Ask for a single JSON object ({"completion":"..."}). Useful for chat models that need a strict output shape.
simpleAutocomplete.responseFormat.description: Chat response format. Ignored in native FIM, where the model returns raw code.

simpleAutocomplete.suggestEditsOnSave.description: After saving a file, ask the model for suggested edits around the cursor and show them as clickable CodeLens actions.

simpleAutocomplete.maxEdits.description: Maximum number of suggested edits shown for one review.
